mathematical_state.global_local_gain: Remains fully closed at its original v0.49 scope.
mathematical_state.scope: The full middle-range estimate StarAD holds at every guarded split and inert index and every good point on the qualifying family. All fifteen Concl fields hold on the same hub, giving ConclF and LinkN with the original finiteness and summability hypotheses. A83G4 reduces GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR to a sufficient family-facts condition on the original class Des(C,3). The formal cut route requires its own arithmetic hypotheses and a comparison back to the uncut family. T83C3 transports the four compatibility conditions to every cut when they hold on the original datum. For counting, the definite row formula, rational near-term rigidity and arithmetic flag counts are proved. The indefinite trace still requires the stated analytic and measure estimates.

new_original_endpoints: A83G1 proves the local and global estimates at every guarded inert C or D point. A83G2 combines these with the split estimate and inert B row to obtain the full native StarAD and Concl.mid, with C2 chosen at least 122 before the family cutoff.

A83G2–A83G3 assemble the fifteen fields on one hub and give ConclF and LinkN on the qualifying family, retaining the native ShaFinOdd and vvTerm summability guards. A83G4 gives a sufficient Closed family-facts condition at the original selected design and transport parameter.

U83M1–U83M6 and S83M1–S83M2 give simultaneous cut lifts, at most four times the local degree times the central multiplicity exceptional classes, and the reduction of the mixed row to signed scalar lifts in finite integral cohomology.

S83L1–S83L4 and D83L1–D83L2 prove every length-one and length-two signed scalar comparison. A83U1–A83U3 prove the up, down, up triple. K83J1–K83J3, K83V1–K83V2 and F83S1–F83S2 prove both cases of the down, up, down triple.

T83A6 proves the cokernel bound at every all-thick place, including the complex-conjugation specialization. H83F1–H83F3 identify the Frobenius and host-digit conditions under which only shorter arcs are needed.
E83D3 bounds the entire exceptional-prime excess in the global denominator sum by 27648 d(j,0) U^6 = d(j,0) o(b) through the original point multiplicities.

C83N1–C83N3 give near unipotence, the exact definite counting formula, thick-region vanishing and the arithmetic ball bound on the original test point. C83N5 proves the complete local near count on every short flag. C83N4 and C83N6 give the moderate far and near integrals under their respective stated premises.
T83C1–T83C3 descend the integral central action and the entire rational eigenspace of each retained point, so the four Tie4 conditions on the original datum imply the four conditions on any cut.

denominator_family.scope_of_typ: Both original type primes and all lifts, with the paired-character field of the native FactsF assumption.
denominator_family.scope_of_large: CongBound_at holds for each sufficiently late member satisfying Facts on every localization passing its original large-prime guards and every admissible family, point and complement. denominator_family.scope_of_ram: For the original twisted indices at p=q,d and their good points, the integral rank estimate at 160 and the complete character estimate on the same local data yield the all-row inequality. The coefficient 2080 and nonnegative polynomial 181 f²t²(r+t) log b suffice. J78H2 gives Concl.ram with the same family constant as J80H2.
